en.title: Taiwan holds local elections under Beijing's watchful gaze
en.dek: Voters across 22 cities and counties cast ballots in Saturday's vote as Chinese authorities weigh in on the race
facts: Taiwan is electing local leaders across 22 cities and counties on Saturday
Chinese authorities have repeatedly weighed in on the race
Campaigners have focused on issues like transport and childcare
Polls opened Saturday morning as reported by DW
The election is described as closely watched by international outlets
Voting is taking place under global media scrutiny
body: Voters across 22 cities and counties cast ballots in Saturday's local election, with polling stations opening Saturday morning according to DW.
Chinese authorities have repeatedly weighed in on the race, as noted by France 24, while campaigners have focused their platforms on issues like transport and childcare.
Polls opened Saturday morning as confirmed by DW's reporting from the scene.
The election is taking place under Beijing's watchful gaze, with Chinese authorities making repeated interventions in the campaign.
Campaigners have focused their platforms on issues like transport and childcare, according to France 24's report on the race.
The vote is described as closely watched by international media, with both France 24 and DW covering the event extensively.
Voters are participating in a contest that has drawn significant attention from Chinese authorities throughout the campaign period.
The election marks another instance of local voting in Taiwan occurring amid Beijing's ongoing political scrutiny.
en.context: Taiwan is holding local elections to select leaders across its 22 cities and counties, with the vote drawing attention from Chinese authorities who have repeatedly weighed in on the race according to international reporting.

en.headline: Taiwan holds local elections under Beijing's watchful gaze
en.body: Taiwan is electing local leaders across 22 cities and counties on Saturday. Chinese authorities have repeatedly weighed in on the race, while campaigners have focused on issues like transport and childcare.

fr.headline: Taiwan organise des élections locales sous le regard vigilant de Pékin
fr.body: Taiwan élit des dirigeants locaux dans 22 villes et comtés samedi. Les autorités chinoises ont multiplié les interventions sur la course, tandis que les candidats se sont concentrés sur des sujets comme les transports et la garde d'enfants.

es.headline: Taiwán celebra elecciones locales bajo la atenta mirada de Pekín
es.body: Taiwán celebra este sábado la elección de líderes locales en 22 ciudades y provincias. Las autoridades chinas han intervenido reiteradamente en la contienda, mientras que los candidatos se han centrado en cuestiones como el transporte y la guardería.

it.headline: Taiwan tiene elezioni locali sotto l'occhio vigile di Pechino
it.body: Taiwan elegge leader locali in 22 città e contee sabato. Le autorità cinesi hanno più volte pesato sulla competizione, mentre i candidati si sono concentrati su temi come trasporti e assistenza all'infanzia.

de.headline: Taiwan hält lokale Wahlen unter wachem Blick Pekings
de.body: Taiwan wählt am Samstag lokale Führungspersonen in 22 Städten und Landkreisen. Chinesische Behörden haben wiederholt in den Wahlkampf eingegriffen, während die Kampagnen sich auf Themen wie Verkehr und Kinderbetreuung konzentrierten.

ja.headline: 台湾、22市県で地方選挙 北京の注視下で
ja.body: 台湾は土曜日、22の市と県で地方の指導者を選出する。中国当局はこの選挙に繰り返し干渉してきたが、選挙陣営は交通や保育などの課題に焦点を当ててきた。

zh.headline: 台湾举行地方选举 备受北京关注
zh.body: 台湾将于周六在22个县市选举地方领导人。中国当局多次对此次选举发表意见，而竞选者一直关注交通和育儿等议题。

pt.headline: Taiwan realiza eleições locais sob o olhar atento de Pequim
pt.body: Taiwan elege líderes locais em 22 cidades e condados no sábado. As autoridades chinesas têm-se pronunciado repetidamente sobre a corrida eleitoral, enquanto os candidatos se têm concentrado em questões como os transportes e os cuidados infantis.

ko.headline: 대만, 베이징의 예리한 감시 속 지방선거 실시
ko.body: 대만은 토요일에 22개 시·현에서 지방자치단체장을 선출한다. 중국 당국은 선거에 거듭 입장을 밝혔고, 후보들은 교통과 보육 같은 현안에 집중했다.
